exposure: gestational age at time of procedure
cohort: The study included 111 pregnant patients undergoing 121 nonobstetrical surgical procedures at a gestational age of 23 weeks or more at the Mayo Clinic between 1992 and 2014.
finding: Nonobstetrical surgical procedures performed during pregnancy at or beyond fetal viability increased the incidence of preterm delivery, although the risk of intraoperative or immediate postoperative obstetrical complications was relatively low.
gest_age: Participants' gestational age at surgery ranged from 23 to 37 weeks (mean 29.2 weeks); preterm delivery occurred at a mean gestational age of 36.9 weeks (range 25-41 weeks).
